nodes.rationale: Not a technical reason: adding a new data processor and opening an account is the owner's decision, and at current traffic the own solution covers the real need (know when manual intervention is required). Switching later is small because OperatorAlert and reportError are the two entry points.

nodes.label: Backend Request Layering (route -> FormRequest -> Controller -> Action -> Resource)
nodes.norm_label: backend request layering (route -> formrequest -> controller -> action -> resource)
nodes.rationale: Thin controllers; one use case per Action with the transaction and the rule; every response goes through a Resource so the model never leaks; predictable business errors are DomainExceptions with a Hungarian message and are not reported.

nodes.norm_label: seeded student accounts verifiedstudent and premiumstudent

nodes.rationale: Spec files share the admin token because login is limited to 5 per minute per account; never log the admin in directly.

nodes.label: ApiClient with per-area helpers and types (src/api/areas, src/api/types)
nodes.norm_label: apiclient with per-area helpers and types (src/api/areas, src/api/types)
nodes.rationale: Area helpers take an ApiClient and build on its public get/post/put/patch/delete/postMultipart/getBinary methods, so ApiClient.ts and types.ts do not grow and two areas never collide; type names must be unique because types.ts re-exports them all.

nodes.label: Barion Pixel and Consent (VITE_BARION_PIXEL_REQUIRES_CONSENT)
nodes.rationale: Barion treats the base Pixel as fraud prevention that runs regardless of consent, but whether it may load before the visitor decides is a privacy question for the owner; the cautious default loads it only after acceptance.

nodes.label: TEST_ENV typed environment (zod-validated, staged .env files)
nodes.rationale: Precedence: real environment variable > <stage>.local.env (gitignored, personal) > <stage>.env; an invalid value stops the run immediately with a clear error.

nodes.label: API tests on MySQL (API_DATABASE_URL, CI job backend-mysql)
nodes.norm_label: api tests on mysql (api_database_url, ci job backend-mysql)
nodes.rationale: Production runs MySQL 8 while local runs default to sqlite, so CI runs the API tests on both engines; locally it is only needed when hunting an engine-specific bug. Fixture loading drops every table, so the backend accepts only a MySQL database whose name ends in _test and only with APP_ENV=testing.

nodes.label: Per-project web server startup (--project selects servers)
nodes.norm_label: per-project web server startup (--project selects servers)
nodes.rationale: Playwright starts only the servers belonging to the selected projects, so E2E runs do not need PHP.

nodes.label: test:prepare-api-fixtures wipes exercise-files and submission-files
nodes.rationale: The command empties backend/storage/app/private/exercise-files and submission-files before every run, so nothing worth keeping may be stored there during local development.

nodes.label: Backup Schedule and Retention (MySQL dump, invoices, videos, exercise files)
nodes.norm_label: backup schedule and retention (mysql dump, invoices, videos, exercise files)

nodes.label: Pre-deploy Database Snapshot (db:snapshot-before-migrate, last 3 on the server)
nodes.norm_label: pre-deploy database snapshot (db:snapshot-before-migrate, last 3 on the server)

nodes.label: Restore Drill (disposable database, row-count comparison, CI backend-mysql job)
nodes.norm_label: restore drill (disposable database, row-count comparison, ci backend-mysql job)
nodes.rationale: A backup is only worth as much as it can be restored from, so the drill runs before go-live and quarterly.

nodes.rationale: Uploaded student solutions are not backed up because the score and evaluation result are in the database and the student can upload the file again; secrets belong in a password manager and the code is on GitHub.

nodes.label: Off-site rclone crypt Storage (S3-compatible bucket)
nodes.rationale: The bucket sits at another provider or machine and data is encrypted on the server so the bucket only holds ciphertext; the crypt password and salt must also live in a password manager or the backups are lost with the server.

nodes.rationale: The frontend never calls Judge0 directly because the Judge0 URL/token must not reach the client and the backend performs the expected-output comparison (with whitespace normalisation) so error messages can be more informative; Judge0 outages return status error with a Hungarian message instead of a 500.

nodes.label: Local-only Development Rule (code reaches the server only through the deploy pipeline)
nodes.norm_label: local-only development rule (code reaches the server only through the deploy pipeline)
nodes.rationale: Never develop, edit code or run migrations by hand on the server; migrations belong to the deploy pipeline. Judge0 is not installed locally but reached through an SSH tunnel.

nodes.rationale: Laravel 11 was blocked by Composer because the whole 11.x line is affected by security advisory PKSA-mdq4-51ck-6kdq and no longer gets fixes; React 19 came with the Vite template and nothing in the plan depended on 18.

nodes.label: Barion (Smart Gateway) payment provider
nodes.rationale: Hungarian provider that settles and pays out in HUF with a payment page familiar to domestic buyers; recurring charges are supported via token payment; fits Hungarian invoicing because our system issues the invoice through Számlázz.hu after a successful charge.

nodes.norm_label: invoice dates in billing_timezone (issue date vs fulfilment date)
nodes.rationale: Invoice dates are calendar days in Europe/Budapest, not UTC; the issue date is the actual issuing day and the fulfilment date is the payment day, so they differ on delayed issuing.

nodes.label: Számlázz.hu Számla Agent
nodes.rationale: Issuing the invoice, NAV submission and e-mail delivery happen in one atomic call, so fewer partial states to handle; it is the most widespread Hungarian invoicing service, accountants know it, and the product owner chose it.

nodes.label: Mandatory Test Agent-key Verification Run
nodes.rationale: The Számlázz.hu docs render client-side and could not be fully verified, so a real request with a test Agent key (element order, sendEmail, late-issue dates) is required before go-live.

nodes.norm_label: billing flow (checkout -> payment -> barion -> syncpaymentstate -> subscription + invoice)
nodes.rationale: Exactly one charge per attempt and exactly one invoice per payment: the payment row is created before calling the provider and guarded by unique indexes.

nodes.label: Unsigned Callback Handling (always query PaymentState, idempotent processing)
nodes.norm_label: unsigned callback handling (always query paymentstate, idempotent processing)
nodes.rationale: The Barion callback is not signed and carries no state, only a signal; so we answer 200 within 15 s, always fetch the real state from the Barion API and process idempotently by PaymentId + state. A forged callback is harmless because it only triggers a lookup; this replaces Stripe-style signature verification.

nodes.label: Exactly One Invoice per Payment (invoices state machine, query before retry)
nodes.norm_label: exactly one invoice per payment (invoices state machine, query before retry)
nodes.rationale: The Számla Agent has no idempotency key, so the invoices row (unique on payment_id, pending -> issued/failed) is locked and checked before the call, the payment request_id is passed as order number, and after an uncertain outcome we query by order number instead of retrying blindly.

nodes.label: Barion Payment Zrt. (card payments, recurring charges)
nodes.norm_label: barion payment zrt. (card payments, recurring charges)
nodes.rationale: Card data is never handled by InfoTanár; the payment provider handles it and receives only e-mail, amount and payment identifier.

nodes.label: Barion Pixel and cookie-consent bar
nodes.rationale: The user decides in the bottom bar and can change the choice any time via the footer 'Sütibeállítások' button. Open decision: whether the fraud-prevention base Pixel loads before consent.

nodes.rationale: The provider keeps uploaded files and practice-exam attempts for 365 days and then deletes them; the user is responsible for uploads and may only upload what they are entitled to. Awaits the owner's legal approval.

nodes.norm_label: sanctum token auth and roles (30-day tokens, student/admin)
nodes.rationale: An invalid token gets 401 even on guest-callable endpoints so an expired session never silently becomes a guest; the admin check runs before model binding so IDs cannot be probed through the 404/403 difference.
